about.title: About Me
about.education: Master's Degree in Software Engineering Student
about.description: Young developer passionate about creating modern and efficient web applications. Curious and self-taught, I enjoy exploring new technologies and applying my knowledge through personal projects.
about.paragraph1: I am motivated by the desire to learn and improve. Although I still lack experience, I am determined to make up for it by getting involved in concrete and stimulating projects. Every opportunity represents a chance for me to grow professionally.
about.paragraph2: My goal is to develop my skills in a collaborative environment while contributing to meaningful projects. I am ready to take on challenges, learn from others, and bring my energy and motivation to a dynamic team.
about.paragraph3: Currently, I am pursuing a Master's in Software Engineering at the University of Bordeaux, which allows me to deepen my knowledge in software design, architecture, and IT project management while developing a rigorous professional approach.
